other_failure_modes.name: Fabricated Submission IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates the submission ID column using a sequential range (e.g., np.arange) instead of extracting the actual identifiers from the test set or a sample submission file, which causes predictions to be misaligned during evaluation.

other_failure_modes.name: Train-Test Contamination via GroupBy Aggregation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent calculates group-wise aggregated features (such as mean, std, min, max) on a concatenated dataset of both training and test sets, causing the test data distribution to leak into the training features.

summary: The agent implements a generally solid pipeline with out-of-fold target encoding, text feature extraction, and optimized ensembling. However, it fails critically by generating fake sequential IDs for the submission file instead of using actual test identifiers, guaranteeing a severely misaligned evaluation. Additionally, it leaks test set statistics into the training data by computing groupby aggregations over a combined train-test dataframe.
